successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: 'modern Yunnan ... the region around the Dian Lake' (the page names no boundary)

capitals.name: Dian Lake basin (seat not named; royal cemetery at Shizhaishan, Jinning)

ledger.x: 279 BC: Zhuang Qiao founds the Dian kingdom at Dian Lake.
109 BC: the Dian kingdom ends; the king receives the Han gold seal ('King Dian's Seal', found at Shizhaishan) and the land becomes Han's Yizhou commandery.

wars.name: Han conquest of Dian
wars.outcome: Han victory: Han troops from Ba and Shu destroyed the allied Laojin and Mimo and the king of Dian surrendered in 109 BCE; Dian became Yizhou commandery.

certainty.note: No boundary is documented; the lake basin and its allies only.
